answer: Each identity must run its own relay: its endpoint is recorded in the cedar registry, and the identity locks a 70 onyx bond. The k-th relay costs one 70 bond plus 40 in dedicated bandwidth per epoch, so 1,000 fake relays cost 110,000 first epoch, while an honest agent pays 40 per epoch plus a single 70 bond, returned after a clean epoch. At its assigned vertex, vertex auditors test every relay in the same minute for sustained 50 Mbps throughput. A shared-link VPS farm fails: one link cannot carry 1,000 50 Mbps streams at once, and each failed test burns that relay's bond.
